name: D2L Inc.
summary: D2L Inc. provides cloud-based learning software for higher education institutions, kindergarten to grade 12 schools and districts, and private sector enterprises in Canada, the United States, and internationally. The company provides personalized, flexible and modern learning experiences for people of all ages. It offers core cloud-based learning innovation platform, Brightspace, serves three distinct markets, such as kindergarten to grade 12 schools (K-12), higher education, and corporate markets.
